I am a 57-year-old woman in Tigray with no schooling, and I farm this small plot the way my mother taught me. I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer or new seeds from the market, so I will use the compost and manure I have at home and plant seeds I saved from last season. My family and I will pull the weeds by hand and depend on the rains, because this land is too small to hire workers and we must be careful with what little we have.
